steps.title: Set it up in a spreadsheet
steps.one: Copy your Webhook URL when you create your key. It is shown once.
steps.two: In a spreadsheet choose Extensions, then Add-ons, then Get add-ons, and install the add-on from the Google Workspace Marketplace. Until it is listed there, paste the six files below into Extensions, Apps Script.
steps.three: Reload the spreadsheet. Choose Extensions, then the add-on, then Initial Setup, and paste the Webhook URL.
steps.four: Pick the sheet and the trigger column. A row is sent when that cell is filled or changed.
steps.five: Select Send Test to check the connection. Nothing is saved; you see the columns the CRM received. Then select Submit.
steps.six: Switch on Send on event (a row is sent as soon as you edit it) and/or Send on schedule (every hour, rows changed by a form or another app). Each row arrives as a contact and its result is written to a CRM status column.
